projects.name: ExampleApp
projects.why: Example entry: a small command-line tool kept healthy by unattended overnight work.
projects.instruction: Continuously improve the shipped product. Reassess existing capabilities, correctness, reliability and material technical debt before admitting new features; preserve verified findings and regression history. Give the local worker one observable behaviour per task, retain explicit file scope and complete acceptance oracles, and prefer suitable licensed open-source reuse.
